description: This PHP source file defines the class 'UnifiedSearchAdvanced', which provides deprecated functionality for advanced unified (global) search within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for building search cache, managing enabled modules, rendering search forms, executing searches, and handling module display settings. The class is part of the legacy search infrastructure for SuiteCRM, with many methods marked as deprecated since v7.12.0.
